professionalSummary.text: The candidate has built store-level demand forecasting models for perishable products.
professionalSummary.witness: Built a LightGBM forecast for 900 fresh-produce lines at store-day level using two years of till data, with features for weather, promotions and bank holidays.

experienceHighlights.text: The candidate maintains feature pipelines for sales, promotion and weather data.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the feature pipeline that joins till sales, promotion calendars and regional weather forecasts, with daily row-count checks on each source and a weekly check of promotion-calendar coverage.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: The candidate has put a forecasting model into production use in a replenishment system and monitored its accuracy after release.

skills.text: The candidate designs and runs store trials with replenishment planners.
skills.witness: Designed an eight-week side-by-side trial in 12 stores: planners saw the model's forecast next to the existing system's figure but kept placing orders from the existing system.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish that the candidate has built store-level demand forecasting models, maintained feature pipelines, put a model into production, designed and run store trials, and communicated results to non-technical stakeholders. They do not establish that the model was deployed in production or that the candidate has experience with supply-chain board sign-off.

decisionBoundary.statement: The materials provide evidence that the candidate meets several requirements for the Data Scientist, Demand Forecasting role, but do not establish all requirements. A qualified human review is required to make a final decision.

evidence.text: Built a LightGBM forecast for 900 fresh-produce lines at store-day level using two years of till data, with features for weather, promotions and bank holidays.
evidence.notes: Clear evidence of building store-level demand forecasting models for perishable products.

evidence.text: Maintained the feature pipeline that joins till sales, promotion calendars and regional weather forecasts, with daily row-count checks on each source and a weekly check of promotion-calendar coverage.
evidence.notes: Clear evidence of maintaining feature pipelines for sales, promotion and weather data.

evidence.text: Work sample: the trial readout for the fresh-produce forecast, covering the 12 trial stores over eight weeks with forecast error by category for the model and for the existing system. The method page restates that orders came from the existing system throughout. Page 6, headed 'Rollout', reads: 'Go-live in all 180 stores from week 32, subject to supply-chain board approval.'
evidence.notes: Clear evidence of putting a forecasting model into production use in a replenishment system and monitoring its accuracy after release.

evidence.text: Designed an eight-week side-by-side trial in 12 stores: planners saw the model's forecast next to the existing system's figure but kept placing orders from the existing system.
evidence.notes: Clear evidence of designing and running store trials with replenishment planners.

evidence.text: Wrote a two-page plain-English summary of the trial results for the fresh category directors, explaining the error measure with worked examples from three products.
evidence.notes: Clear evidence of communicating forecast results to non-technical stakeholders.
